task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the wger fitness manager as admin.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dashboard or main menu of wger is visible, showing 'admin' as the logged-in user.

task_completion.description: Agent selects or navigates to the '5x5 Beginner' routine to start a session.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text '5x5 Beginner' is visible in the routine selection or session creation screen.

task_completion.description: Agent sets the session date to today and adds the required note and an impression.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text field containing 'Solid squat session, nearly hit all reps' and a selected impression (e.g., a smiley face or rating) are visible.

task_completion.description: Agent adds the 'Squats' exercise to the workout session.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The exercise name 'Squats' is added to the current workout log.

task_completion.description: Agent logs three sets for Squats with the specific weights and reps (100kg: 5, 5, 4).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Three distinct rows or entries for Squats showing: Set 1: 100kg/5 reps, Set 2: 100kg/5 reps, Set 3: 100kg/4 reps.

task_completion.description: Agent saves or finishes the workout session.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Success' message, a 'Session saved' notification, or the completed session appearing in the calendar/log history.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on buttons, and text entry into web forms rather than terminal windows.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus to find the routine and log.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the transition from the dashboard to the workout/calendar section.

integrity.description: The agent did not bypass the UI by guessing direct API endpoints or internal IDs in the URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking elements like 'Add session' or 'Log' rather than just jumping to a final confirmation page.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The routine name must be exactly '5x5 Beginner'. The exercise is 'Squats'. The required note is 'Solid squat session, nearly hit all reps'. The specific set data to verify is: Set 1 (100 kg, 5 reps), Set 2 (100 kg, 5 reps), and Set 3 (100 kg, 4 reps). The user must be logged in as 'admin'.
